slots.title: Trump floats keeping Iranian oil; Hormuz talks stall
slots.body:
Trump said the U.S. may keep Iranian oil “like Venezuela” as talks between Gulf countries and Iran on the Strait of Hormuz have been postponed.

The strait is the main route for global oil and gas flows; the meeting was set for Oman.

Brent crude was up 3.1% to 107.88 in the session.

What’s your read on how long Hormuz stays in the headlines?

slots.title: 10-year Treasury yield at 5.0%
slots.body:
The 10-year Treasury yield is at 5.0%.

That’s close to the 5% level last touched in October 2023.

The gap between 2-year (4.6%) and 10-year (5.0%) yields — the “2s10s spread” — is 0.33 percentage points.

Coverage has focused on whether a rise is driven by growth, inflation, fiscal concerns, or market stress.

Where do you track the 10-year for context on rates?

slots.title: Saudi pipeline shut; Brent up 3.1% to 107.88
slots.body:
Saudi Arabia shut the East-West pipeline that bypasses the Strait of Hormuz after drones launched from Iraq damaged it.

Riyadh has not disclosed how badly it is damaged or how long it will stay closed.

Brent crude rose 3.1% to 107.88.

Gold futures were down 0.8% to 4,375.20 in the same session.

How are you weighing supply routes vs. demand when you look at oil?
